_about: The wet look of the open air in rain (WetRules; the 3D view's WetLayer and the ground shader's wet uniforms, the flat view's tints on the ground tiles, roofs and stone props). Weather is one look a day, so the rain 'starts' when the day does (`day_start`): the wetness (0..1) grows to the look's `max` over `grow_hours` of game time, as the puddles do (data/puddles.json), and when a rainy day is followed by a dry one it dries out linearly over `dry_hours` from `day_start` (Game.weather_yesterday; so it is dry again by late morning). None while any snow lies (a snow-covered surface is never wet), indoors, under the greenhouse glass or in the mine. `surfaces`: how a kind of surface looks fully wet: `dark` its brightness (a multiplier), `sat` its saturation (a gain about the grey of the same brightness), `gloss` 0..1 how glossy (3D: the roughness and specular move to `gloss.roughness` / `gloss.specular` by it; the ground gets a sky sheen of `sheen.share` and a sun glint of `sheen.glint` by it). Tilled soil darkest; kawara tile the glossiest; thatch and kaya darken little and stay matt; grass barely changes. `ground`: the farm's and the maps' ground kinds to a surface (water, the greenhouse beds and floors none). `materials`: the 3D surfaces' picture keys (PlaceholderArt; a key or its variants `key:N`) to a surface; a lit plain colour is `plain.stone` when it is a grey (saturation under `plain.grey`), else `plain.other`; unshaded, glowing, see-through and unlisted pictures stay as they are (paper, glass, cloth). `flat`: the flat view's prop kinds drawn as plain boxes to a surface, the painted roofs' materials (RoofArt) to a surface, and `drips`: pale glints on the bottom eave of the painted roofs from `drips.min` wetness, one every `every` px (by a hash). Balance numbers are ours.
marks: A material may carry the meta `wet_surface` (WetRules.mark): its surface, even unshaded or see-through (the silo's and the greenhouse's flat-colored timber, hoops and stone, the greenhouse glass).
